scope: Public primary references, separated by inspection method and quality of reach evidence. Creative recipes are original proposals, not production reconstructions.
causality_note: Reach does not establish which editing choices caused it or predict performance of adaptations.
media_policy: No reference footage or extracted frames are included in this repository.
